required_limitation: The F11 result is based on one HG002 individual, one pathogenic F11 locus, one Dorado/basecalling configuration and one controlled worked-case attack setting.
No patient outcome, treatment decision, morbidity, mortality or real clinical ingestion was measured.
The S5-to-S6 storage extension is modelled E5 propagation rather than directly observed lifecycle propagation.
The Privacy GRI is predominantly model-derived and should not be interpreted as an observed population probability.
D1, D3 and D5 share the B2 lifetime-model evidence family and are not independent empirical confirmations.
Containment difficulty is strongly dependent on attack origin and network topology in the project model.
Equal weighting is a transparent baseline rather than an empirically validated optimal weighting scheme.
M1-M5 modifiers are reported separately and are not mathematically incorporated into the primary Base GRI.
Evidence tiers are categorical ordinal support classes and are not calibrated confidence probabilities.
V6/V7 establish internal structural and deterministic sensitivity properties, not external validation across populations, tools or clinical environments.
